study_relation: Prospective scenario analysis after observed capability study; sealed original remains unchanged.
operating_arrangement: Full attributed ownership cost. No provider invoice or fee is added to underlying provider costs.
scenario_quality_status: All field path probabilities and assumed human final acceptance are hypothetical, not fitted to 42/42 fixture acceptance.
model_identity_status: Hypothetical deployment models; not the actual research host or proof of performance. These orchestration calls were not required or used by the frozen native job.
labor_role_pricing: Employer and traditional-worker time use the selected local price basis. Provider operator and engineering time use U.S. professional compensation in every case; no double benefits load.

cloud.idle_zero_reason: Declared scale-to-zero prospective configuration; shared support/monitoring remains positively costed.
cloud.billing_scope: Each scenario request occupies its own allocated instance during executor events; up to two instances run in parallel. There is no assumed cross-request CPU sharing discount.
cloud.fixed_runtime_allocation: Initial/monthly total occupied seconds are distributed equally over their explicit request counts before 100ms per-request rounding; this is an input allocation assumption, not measured cloud usage.

storage.operations_and_egress: Separate explicit USD allowance per requested job; not included in at-rest tariff.

resources.capacity_policy: Subtract fixed usage from matching pools; apply scenario utilization to available time/token budgets; money budget is full attributed economic cost, not cash. Also constrain occupied executor time by remaining calendar after setup.
resources.token_budget_status: ASSUMED_AGGREGATE_ANNUAL_BUDGETS; not actual provider rate limits, quotas, latency guarantees or observed consumption.

time_pool_residual_rule.effective: max(0,min(annual,postdeployment)); initial usage is NOT subtracted again from postdeployment.
time_pool_residual_rule.token_rule: Annual assumed aggregate token budgets * utilization minus initial and recurring token usage; no time-based quota claimed.
time_pool_residual_rule.hybrid_setup_days: Agent setup plus traditional setup, sequential.

base.label: Base planning assumptions; not estimated or most likely

stress.label: Stress: persistent hard work, repeated review, high upkeep and low demand

traditional.acceptance_status: Favorable assumed competent-human completion; not a measurement.
traditional.productive_scope: Source inspection, compiling/formatting brief and slides, and worker self-check; excludes separately charged client intake, independent review, correction and delivery.
traditional.correction_probability_and_minutes: Scenario-specific fields; correction work is traditional worker time, rereview is employer time.
traditional.resource_allocation: Traditional worker time has its own pool; employer intake/review uses the same employer pool as Agent comparison.

hybrid.charge: Every failed/refused Agent path plus scenario handoff employer minutes plus full traditional variable workflow; add traditional fixed readiness and ordinary-tool cost. No credit for prior failed Agent labor.
hybrid.setup_calendar: Agent and human readiness delays are sequential; add both for first-commission latency and service-calendar bound.
hybrid.human_worker_pool: Full traditional production/correction minutes use the traditional-worker pool; employer handoff/intake/review uses employer pool.
hybrid.break_even: For fixed volume, hybrid A0+bA*t versus human H0+bH*t. Positive slope difference gives (A0-H0)/(bH-bA); equal/nonpositive slopes reported explicitly. Pure Agent has bA=0.

one_way_sensitivities.anchor: US_office base scenario, annual cohort, traditional productive30min; only the named driver changes.

native_delivery_no_model_or_paid_search.quality_probabilities_unchanged_for_sens: Not performance equivalence; real full-service quality remains unmeasured.

transform_scope.requested_reuse_volume: Change requested demand only; retain annual fixed horizon, all probabilities and resource budgets.
transform_scope.delivery_model_token_multiplier: Multiply delivery input/output tokens only; retain calls, fees, fixed construction/maintenance tokens, latency and quality assumptions.
transform_scope.employer_review_effort_multiplier: Multiply employer event fields independent_review, independent_rereview, challenge_adjudication, rejection_review and refusal_review; apply same factor to traditional independent review/rereview. Do not change source prep, productive duration, manual correction, fixed effort, waits or quality.
transform_scope.unsuccessful_initial_construction_human_: Multiply only initial_provider_hours.unsuccessful_capability_construction; initial shared model/tool budget remains unchanged and still fully charged.
transform_scope.recurring_support_and_upkeep_multiplier: Multiply monthly provider/employer hours, monthly model tokens/search/executor usage and monthly cash allowances. Keep shared storage and per-request artifact retention unchanged. Human baseline recurring costs remain unchanged because this driver describes Agent upkeep.
transform_scope.native_delivery_no_model_or_paid_search: Zero delivery model calls/input/output and successful paid search only; all fixed construction/upkeep and other delivery resources remain positively budgeted. No change to assumed quality/latency.

tax_allowance_scope: Scenario fraction applies to nonlabor technology/cash costs only; not wages or their benefits, not an official tax rate, and not a claim of actual tax liability.

rationale.branch_weights: Declared joint planning assumptions to expose stable jobs, repair, transient failure, persistent difficulty and final failure; no empirical frequency claim.
rationale.event_token_and_time_budgets: Inspectable prospective allowances for a small evidence pack; broad stress and one-way ranges acknowledge unmeasured model/orchestration usage.
rationale.fixed_hours: Explicit engineering, unsuccessful search and qualification effort rather than assigning free retained tools; not historical authoring reconstruction.
rationale.demand_and_utilization: Finite independently declared workload and usable capacity; no infinite-amortization assumption.
rationale.same_prices_for_roles: Local employer/worker rate varies by price basis; a common disclosed U.S. professional provider-support cost avoids clerical pricing of engineering. This is a scenario geography choice, not an observed bill.

evaluation_authorization: Model implementation/run and derived scenario values prohibited until coordinator confirms public freeze hash.

price_bases.scope_limit: Office/admin total compensation is the primary administrative-brief price basis; no matched task duration or field quality observation.
Broad professional total compensation, not a matched occupation or a service billing rate.
Wage-only technical writer median; 1.30 load is assumed, not measured benefits.
Covered-economy employer cost, not a matched technical-writer rate.

provider_labor.scope: Same U.S.-based professional support/engineering cost basis for all examples; translate with fixed FX. A broad labor-cost proxy, not a contractor quote.

material_consequence_boundary.supported_scope: Low-consequence administrative evidence draft, with competent review before use.
material_consequence_boundary.reported_total: Modeled operational resource cost, not an empirical all-consequence field cost.

human_queue_policy: Traditional queue_wait_seconds is multiplied by scenario external_wait multiplier. Correction/rereview employer effort uses scenario human_minutes multiplier; productive t and explicit correction minutes are not multiplied again.
scaling_rules: Delivery model_tokens multiplier applies to event token totals, not call counts. human_minutes multiplier applies to all event employer/provider minutes and traditional common employer/rereview minutes. executor_occupancy and external_wait multiply their event fields. Native measured subcomponent stays unscaled and included; native invocation counts do not change. Fixed initial/monthly scenario quantities are already explicit and receive no delivery multiplier.

model_execution_identity.status: No API deployment or invocation is performed. Published product-name tariffs are frozen; no actual served model or operational performance is asserted.
